critical_code_review_comments: Good: /admin/orders-batch/accept uses non-parametric segment ('orders-batch') to avoid colliding with /admin/orders/{id}/accept. Verified via test where POSTing to /admin/orders/batch/accept resolves to parametric route and returns 404 (order_id='batch' not found) rather than routing to the batch handler.
Good: batch-accept only flips orders currently in 'pending' status — prevents double-accepting already-preparing orders (update_one filter {id, status:'pending'}).
Good: RejectDialog testids use kebab-case derived from reason label (reject-reason-out-of-stock etc.). Review request spec mentions these loosely; implementation choice is consistent.
Good: chime preview uses Web Audio API only — zero network requests to audio files observed during entire interaction (bell/soft/ding/double previews all synthesized client-side).
Good: localStorage key 'culinary_queue_settings_v1' is versioned (good migration path); persisted shape confirmed: {muted,volume,chime,escalation_seconds,desktop_notifications}.

Nit: admin_live_queue uses UTC start_of_day which may misreport 'today' for non-UTC store operators; acceptable for current single-timezone app but worth noting if storefront timezone config is added later.

Nit: summary.avg_prep_minutes is derived from (updated_at - accepted_at). If an order advances through multiple status updates, 'updated_at' will track the latest transition (may not be the ready transition). For stricter 'prep time' semantics, stamp a dedicated 'ready_at'.
